query: How visible is our brand in AI search? We are Homebase CRM for real estate agents.
expected_behavior: Asks for or proposes a fixed, dated prompt set by query type with engines, locations and run counts
Defines mention rate, citation rate, share of voice and accuracy with denominators
Uses first-party sources where available (Search Console, Bing AI Performance, GA4 referrals, logs) and labels limits

query: ChatGPT never mentions us. Is our site blocking AI bots?
expected_behavior: Checks robots.txt and server/CDN rules for named crawlers (e.g. OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot/Google-Extended)
Distinguishes search/retrieval crawlers from training crawlers and explains trade-offs

query: Run one prompt in ChatGPT and tell me our share of voice.
expected_behavior: Explains that one run is not a reliable sample because AI answers vary
Recommends repeated runs across a prompt set and reports results with dates and sample sizes
